subject: Entitlement mapping + co-sell demo playbook for BrightGrid (AWS Private Offer)
messages:
From: BrightGrid Sales <sales@brightgrid.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@brightgrid.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: AWS Private Offer & entitlement mapping for BrightGrid listing

Hi Rishi / Ben,

Thanks for taking a look. We're working to get BrightGrid listed as an ISV on AWS with a Private Offer (sell-with) and need help mapping our internal SKUs / entitlements to the AWS Private Offer structure. High-level asks: 

- Confirm which entitlements Redwood needs to surface for co-sell attribution (trial vs paid, demo credits).
- Representative evidence we should attach for marketplace certification (SOC links, architecture diagram).
- A short tech-demo where we walk through the integrated deployment and entitlement propagation (30–45m).

I've attached our evidence binder and an entitlement spreadsheet to speed triage. Proposed demo windows next week: Tue 4/2 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 4/3 14:00–15:00 PT.

Attachments: BrightGrid-evidence-binder.pdf, brightgrid-entitlement-mapping.xlsx

Cheers,
Asha Rao
Head of Partnerships, BrightGrid
asha@brightgrid.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

--
BrightGrid, Inc. | Cloud data ops for regulated workloads

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha@brightgrid.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: AWS Private Offer & entitlement mapping for BrightGrid listing

Thanks Asha — appreciate the packet. Quick read-through and a proposed playbook below; happy to refine in the demo.

High-level plan (what Redwood will own):
- Evidence triage: Monica will validate SOC2/architecture links and confirm anything missing for AWS listing.
- Entitlement translation: Ben will map BrightGrid SKU rows to Redwood/Marketplace entitlements (trial flag, sku_id, meterable boolean).
- Catalog config: Karthik will advise on sku-binding and private offer metadata to ensure co-sell attribution flows to both BrightGrid and Redwood.
- Demo + handoff: I'll run a 30–45m joint demo; we aim to end with a mutual action plan and timeline for Private Offer submission.

Immediate asks for you (before demo):
1) Confirm which SKUs in the spreadsheet are intended for trial vs paid (column: intended_tier).
2) Share a link to any compliance evidence (SOC/ISO reports) you want listed in the AWS evidence binder.
3) If you have a proposed SOW (even draft), drop it in the Drive link — we'll look for billing cadence and demo-credit clauses.

Proposed meeting: Tue 2028-04-02 10:00 PT — Ben and Monica can join. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

On attachments, noted: BrightGrid-evidence-binder.pdf and entitlement spreadsheet received. Monica, can you triage and surface gaps? Ben, please start a mapping sheet with our sku namespace.

Thanks — Rishi
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

From: BrightGrid Sales <sales@brightgrid.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@brightgrid.ai, aws-privatelisting@amazon.com
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: AWS Private Offer & entitlement mapping for BrightGrid listing

Rishi — thanks, that plan looks good. Quick updates: 

- Confirmed SKUs: we've added an "intended_tier" column in the sheet (Trial / Paid / Promo). Please use the updated file: brightgrid-entitlement-mapping.xlsx (v2).
- Evidence: uploaded SOC2 summary + network topology to Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cBrightGridEvidence
- SOW: attached a draft SOW (SOW-draft-BD-4391.docx) with billing cadence (monthly), demo-credit clause (3 demo credits), and a requested go-live target: early June.

We can do Tue 4/2 10:00 PT. Proposed agenda: 1) 10m intros + objectives, 2) 15m entitlement mapping walkthrough, 3) 15m tech demo (BrightGrid in Redwood demo tenant), 4) 5m next steps / MAP.

Attachments: SOW-draft-BD-4391.docx, brightgrid-entitlement-mapping.xlsx (v2)

Best,
Asha Rao

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha@brightgrid.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: AWS Private Offer & entitlement mapping for BrightGrid listing

Asha — great, thanks for the updates and the SOW. I've started a mapping draft (internal) and will share a cleaned sheet before the demo. Initial notes: 
- There are three BrightGrid metered SKUs that need explicit mapping to Redwood meter IDs. I'll flag them in the mapping sheet.
- For co-sell attribution, we need the private-offer metadata (partner_id, offer_alias) and confirmation that BrightGrid will accept Redwood as a sell-with partner in the Private Offer.
- Monica: I'll hand the evidence PDF to you; please confirm whether AWS wants full SOC2 report or a summary link.

Rishi — I'll create the invite for Tue 2028-04-02 10:00 PT (30 min) and include a join link. Looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Partner Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
